chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying regarding the man marrying the woman by Mut'ah that they inherit each other if they did not stipulate [otherwise], and the stipulation is after the marriage.
ai.seo_question: Do spouses in Mut'ah marriage inherit from each other by default?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that in temporary marriage (Mut'ah), spouses automatically inherit from one another unless they explicitly stipulate otherwise, emphasizing that such conditions are applied post-contract. This ruling highlights the flexibility of Mut'ah contracts in Shia jurisprudence, where default legal effects can be modified by mutual agreement, distinguishing it from permanent marriage where inheritance is generally unconditional. The narration underscores the importance of explicit stipulation in determining financial rights within this specific marital form.
